info.name: MST Social MVP - live Instagram verification
info.description: Tests this application's HTTP API while MST_INSTAGRAM_PROVIDER_MODE=searchapi. Run requests 1-3, copy the marker returned by request 2 into the Instagram biography for username, wait until it is visible, then run requests 4-5. Use an Instagram account you control. Each verification check can consume a SearchAPI request. A challenge expires after 15 minutes. Use a fresh username for a new successful verification under the same tenant; the app does not allow the same Instagram handle to be linked twice.

request.description: Set username to a public Instagram account you control. Copy the marker from the response into that account's biography. Do not put the SearchAPI key into this request; the server uses it internally.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('apiKey')) { throw new Error('Set the Postman apiKey variable to the same MST_LOCAL_API_KEY configured in IntelliJ.'); }
pm.test('API key accepted (401: check Authorization Bearer token and IntelliJ MST_LOCAL_API_KEY)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(401); });

pm.test('Challenge created with a marker', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(body.provider).to.eql('instagram'); pm.expect(body.verificationId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.marker).to.match(/^mst_[A-Z2-7]{26}$/); pm.expect(body.expiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('Status is pending and marker is hidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.verificationId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('verificationId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('marker'); });

request.description: Run only after the marker from request 2 is visible in the real Instagram biography. The server reads the biography through SearchAPI. This request can consume a SearchAPI credit. A 503 with result PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE means the provider could not supply usable evidence; a 200 with MARKER_NOT_FOUND means the returned biography did not include this challenge's marker. Unsuccessful observations can use one of the five allowed attempts.

exec: pm.test('Instagram account verified', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.verificationId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('verificationId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(body.result).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(body.attemptCount).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Status is verified and marker is hidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.verificationId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('verificationId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('marker'); });
